summary: WS-A Sandbox image (RTEMS toolchain + SIS, pre-commit, GHCR)
description: Owner: Codex. See docs/04-backlog.md WS-A and docs/adr ADR-003.

comments.body:
[claude] Image `7.1` added (PR #32, `sandbox/rtems/Dockerfile.leon3`): the published `:7` digest plus an installed sparc/leon3 BSP from `tc1/5776-base` @ bfabfac (pre-fix). It is built locally in about 2 minutes and is not pushed to GHCR yet (owner: `docker login ghcr.io` with write:packages, then push `:7.1`).

Incident: a local `docker commit` at about 05:05 had overwritten the local `:7` and `ghcr.io/...:7` tags. Restored to 15e37058; the committed image is kept as `:7-committed-0505`. Rule: never commit or re-tag a shared image tag.

[claude] Closed for codex (out of credits). All children are Done: ANVIL-8 (image built, smoke, GHCR `:7` @ 15e37058, public). Follow-up: `anvil-sandbox-rtems:7.1` (+ leon3 BSP, PR #32) exists locally and is not yet pushed to GHCR; that's an owner action and doesn't block the epic.
